name: Life Souls
detailed_description:
Life Souls is a cooperative roguelike in the Action RPG genre, where every battle is a challenge, and every victory makes you stronger. Dynamic battles in arenas, unexpected events and epic bosses are waiting for you, ready to test the limits of your capabilities.

  • Co-op up to 6 players - fight shoulder to shoulder with friends or risk it alone.

  • Unique builds - unlock new skills and combine them with artifacts to create devastating combinations.

  • Class system - choose the class you like, experiment with skills and find a fighting style that suits you.

  • Artifacts - earn gold in battle and buy powerful equipment within the session.

  • Epic bosses - large-scale battles await you after waves of enemies that will test your training.

  • Arena Events - unexpected challenges turn the battlefield into chaos or give you an advantage.

  • Pets are faithful assistants who help collect resources for you.

  • Constant progression - discover new skills, pump your soul, making each subsequent passage even more interesting.

Can you pass all the tests and face the final boss?
